title: BOQ Digital Banking Platform
description: Senior frontend delivery for BOQ banking experiences under NRI ANZ. Standardized reusable UI patterns and release guardrails, reducing production risk and improving release readiness in regulated workflows.

caseStudy.role: Senior frontend engineer responsible for architecture, implementation standards, and delivery quality across critical customer journeys.
caseStudy.challenge: Shipping in a regulated environment required balancing fast iterations with strict reliability, security, and review requirements.
approach: Standardized reusable UI patterns to reduce inconsistency across teams and squads.
Introduced release guardrails and review checks for risky UI changes.
Strengthened test strategy for key flows to reduce regression risk.
architecture: Feature-oriented frontend structure for scalable ownership boundaries.
Typed contracts and shared utilities to enforce consistency.
Progressive rollout pattern for high-risk changes.
quality: Automated test coverage for critical user paths.
PR review checklist for reliability and accessibility.
Post-release validation workflow for faster issue detection.
caseStudy.outcome: Improved platform reliability and release confidence while keeping delivery velocity sustainable in regulated workflows.

title: Helika Analytics Platform
description: Owned frontend architecture for a data-heavy analytics platform, including dashboard performance tuning and team delivery standards; improved perceived responsiveness and reduced regression escapes.

caseStudy.role: Senior frontend owner for architecture and performance of analytics surfaces used by internal and external stakeholders.
caseStudy.challenge: Data-heavy dashboards suffered from rendering bottlenecks and inconsistent patterns that slowed delivery.
approach: Optimized rendering paths for large datasets and expensive components.
Created reusable dashboard patterns and state management conventions.
Embedded quality standards into reviews and team workflows.
architecture: Modular dashboard composition using React and TypeScript.
Predictable state handling with Redux Toolkit.
Shared visualization primitives for consistency and speed.
quality: Performance budgets for primary dashboard pages.
Component-level test strategy for critical interactions.
Structured code reviews to prevent drift and regressions.
caseStudy.outcome: Delivered faster dashboards and more reliable releases while improving maintainability for future feature work.

title: Real Estate Operations Suite
description: Built internal operations tooling with Next.js and React Native, improving workflow reliability and maintainability; reduced manual effort and improved on-time operational completion.

caseStudy.role: Senior frontend contributor across web and mobile experiences with shared ownership of delivery outcomes.
caseStudy.challenge: Operations teams relied on fragmented manual workflows that created delays and avoidable errors.
approach: Mapped high-friction workflows and prioritized high-impact automation.
Built consistent web and mobile interfaces for daily operations.
Partnered with backend teams for robust integrations and data consistency.
architecture: Shared TypeScript domain models across app surfaces.
Workflow-first UI design for repeatable operational tasks.
Service integration boundaries aligned with backend ownership.
quality: Validation and guardrails for high-impact operational actions.
Regression testing around critical workflow transitions.
Monitoring hooks for reliability and supportability.
caseStudy.outcome: Reduced manual overhead and improved execution reliability for operational teams.

title: Entrego Logistics Applications
description: Led frontend modernization for last-mile logistics applications; improved engineering velocity, reduced incident frequency, and established a more predictable release cadence.

caseStudy.role: Frontend lead driving modernization initiatives and delivery coordination for logistics product surfaces.
caseStudy.challenge: Legacy frontend patterns slowed feature delivery and created recurring production issues.
approach: Refactored brittle UI modules into reusable and testable components.
Aligned delivery practices with stronger review and release processes.
Collaborated with design to improve UX consistency in core journeys.
architecture: Component reuse model to reduce duplicate logic.
State flow cleanup for easier maintenance and debugging.
Gradual modernization to avoid risky full rewrites.
quality: Stabilization-first roadmap to address high-frequency incident areas.
UI consistency standards shared across teams.
caseStudy.outcome: Improved maintainability, release predictability, and platform stability while continuing feature delivery.

title: Enterprise Batch Processing Workflows
description: Delivered SQL-centric automation for enterprise batch workflows, increasing throughput and reducing failed overnight runs in reliability-critical systems.

caseStudy.role: Engineer focused on reliability and performance improvements for enterprise batch processing systems.
caseStudy.challenge: Overnight workflows had failure hotspots that impacted downstream reporting and business operations.
approach: Identified bottlenecks and optimized critical SQL and PL/SQL paths.
Introduced resilience checks for failure-prone batch stages.
Worked with stakeholders to prioritize the highest-risk process windows.
architecture: Batch orchestration improvements around high-volume data steps.
Query and transaction optimizations for predictable throughput.
Operational visibility enhancements for support teams.
quality: Guardrails for failure handling and restart safety.
Validation checks for data integrity in batch outputs.
Operational runbook support for faster incident recovery.
caseStudy.outcome: Increased batch reliability and throughput in systems where processing windows were business-critical.
